string-array.name: help_bodies
string-array.item: Hermes Text Editor is a simple, offline-focused editor for text and Markdown files.
Tap New to start a blank document. When you are ready, tap Save and choose a name and folder.
Tap Open to choose a .txt or .md file from Android\'s file picker. You can also open a supported file from your Android file manager and choose Hermes Text Editor.
Write and edit normally. The file name appears below the app title. If a file name is long, swipe it sideways to see the complete name.

Markdown files open in Preview mode. Use the three-dot menu to choose Edit Markdown and change the original Markdown text. Choose Preview Markdown to read the formatted result. Saving keeps the original Markdown source.
Tap Save to update the currently open file. For a new document, Save opens the save screen so you can choose a name and folder.
Press and hold Save ▲, then choose Save as…. Create another copy with a different name, folder, or .txt / .md extension. Save as keeps your text exactly as written.
Press and hold Save ▲, then choose Export as plain text…. This creates a separate .txt copy without Markdown formatting symbols. Your original Markdown file is not changed.

Hermes may suggest Right-to-Left for a Persian document or Left-to-Right for an English document when the current writing direction does not match. You can always change this manually in the three-dot menu under Text direction.
Use the three-dot menu to switch between Light and Dark themes, or between English and فارسی. These choices are saved on your device.
In Markdown Preview, tap a web link to open it in your browser. Only normal http and https links should be opened.

Hermes Text Editor is designed to work offline. It does not include ads, analytics, tracking, or a WebView. Your files stay on your device except when you choose to open or save them through Android\'s file picker.
